rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken intensifier for “very,” “extremely,” or “to a great extent.”
Use this before an adjective or verb when singling something out as especially or unusually so, rather than simply saying it is very so.

example.english: I particularly like this cha chaan teng.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dak6 bit6 zung1 ji3 ni1 gaan1 caa4 gei3
